summary: The page exhibits visual defects including severe contrast degradation in the header title and an overlapping hover card obstructing code readability in the code pane.

issues.title: Header title low contrast
issues.description: The primary profile name in the header is rendered with low-contrast dark text, making it nearly illegible against the dark background.
issues.evidence: The text 'Amara Chen' below 'WORKSPACE / PROFILE' is barely visible compared to the subtitle beneath it.
issues.suggestion: Apply high-contrast text color tokens for headings in dark mode.

issues.title: Hover card obscures code text
issues.description: The inspect/documentation popup directly overlaps active code lines, truncating and obscuring text.
issues.evidence: Lines 1 through 11 have their right sides blocked by the floating function signature card.
issues.suggestion: Offset the popover or reposition it to avoid occluding active code lines.
